subject: Post-call: DPA election, SCC module preference & security questionnaire kickoff
messages:
From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>
To: Ella Thompson <ella@finbridge.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 5 Sep 2027 21:02:00 +0000
Subject: Post-call: DPA election, SCC module preference & security questionnaire kickoff

Hi Ella — thanks again for the call earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a single place to track: 

What we covered
- FinBridge data flows and anticipated EU processing footprint (mostly token-level telemetry and encrypted customer payloads).
- Primary ask: formal DPA + confirmation of SCC module selection for cross-border transfers.
- SOC 2 status and vendor questionnaire timeline (you asked what we can provide quickly).

Redwood’s position / proposed items
- Role alignment: Redwood will act as Processor; FinBridge remains Controller. Please confirm this matches your legal view.
- SCC selection: based on the call, FinBridge favored the Controller-to-Processor module. Our legal team recommends Processor-sided language in Module 2 (Controller-to-Processor) with a small addendum for limited subprocessing transparency. If you prefer a different SCC flavor, flag it and we can route.
- DPA: attaching our standard DPA (Redwood_DPA_v2.docx). We can accept redlines but will need Legal to review — see timelines below.
- SOC 2: Redwood has a Type II report for the period Jan–Jun 2027. We’ll provide the cover letter and the AOC once a mutual NDA or secure transfer channel is agreed.

Immediate asks / owners
- FinBridge: please confirm Controller/Processor designation (one-line confirmation by reply). (Action: Ella)
- Redwood Legal (Hannah): prepare a clean DPA + SCC Module 2 variant for FinBridge to review (Action: Hannah).
- Redwood Security (Vanessa): initiate vendor security questionnaire process and send the secure link/instructions to FinBridge. (Action: Vanessa).
- Neha to coordinate timelines and closing milestones for the deal. (Action: Neha).

Proposed timeline
- 48 hours: FinBridge confirms role designation.
- 3 business days: Redwood Legal sends DPA + SCC draft with minor customizations.
- 5 business days: Security questionnaire completed (depending on answers / docs provided).

Attachments: Redwood_DPA_v2.docx (DPA template), Vendor_Security_Questionnaire_instructions.txt (instructions + secure link placeholder).

If that aligns, I’ll mark this as the official thread and Hannah/Vanessa will follow through. Thanks — looking forward to the confirmation from Ella.

Best,
Chloe Martin
Senior AE, Redwood Inference
chloe.martin@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0132
Redwood Inference

From: Ella Thompson <ella@finbridge.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>
Cc: FinBridge Legal <legal@finbridge.com>
Date: Mon, 6 Sep 2027 09:18:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Post-call: DPA election, SCC module preference & security questionnaire kickoff

Thanks Chloe — quick answers and a few clarifying questions: 

1) Controller/Processor: FinBridge will be Controller, Redwood Processor — we can confirm in writing; please assume this is the case for the DPA draft.
2) SCC: Our GC prefers the Controller-to-Processor module as you suggested. If Redwood’s draft uses Module 2 language, that should be fine.
3) SOC 2: we need to see the Type II AOC and the cover letter; if you can provide those via a secure transfer link that would be helpful.
4) HIPAA: a subset of our customers are in healthcare and will require HIPAA assurances. Do you have a current HIPAA attestation or BA agreement template? If not, note we’ll flag this during contracting.

Security questionnaire timeline: we can start filling this week but would like the secure link and instructions so we can route to our security ops. Target to complete within 5 business days from receipt.

Thanks — I’ll await Hannah’s DPA draft and Vanessa’s secure questionnaire link.

Best,
Ella Thompson
Head of Security Programs, FinBridge
ella@finbridge.com
+44 20 7946 0123

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2027 16:45:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Post-call: DPA election, SCC module preference & security questionnaire kickoff

Thanks Chloe — noted. A few internal notes / next steps from Legal: 

1) DPA / SCC draft: I’ll prepare Redwood’s DPA with Module 2 (Controller-to-Processor) language and a short addendum to surface subprocessor notification cadence and data export obligations. Expect a first pass within 3 business days. We will leave a clear redline section for retention and deletion clauses because FinBridge’s HIPAA scope may require tighter controls.

2) SOC 2 delivery: Chloe — we will provide the SOC 2 Type II AOC and cover letter via the secure transfer link Vanessa will create. We should avoid attachment in plain email.

3) HIPAA / BA: we do not publish a generic BA template; if FinBridge requires a formal BA, Legal will need to evaluate scope and may require a controlled scoping call. Please flag the specific product modules that touch PHI.

4) Timeline / negotiation touches: propose the following cadence — legal draft (3 business days), FinBridge review (3–5 business days), targeted execution in ~2 weeks if there are no material redlines. If FinBridge requests substantive HIPAA BA changes, that may extend timeline.

I’ll draft and drop into the HubSpot deal record and copy FinBridge legal on the DPA draft email. Vanessa — please share the secure questionnaire link with Ella and include the Drive path where supporting evidence (SOC 2 AOC) will be uploaded.

Thanks — Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Head of Legal, Redwood Inference
